bibl.title: Gli attributi del mese "corrente".
bibl.seg: Roberto Mascellari, Gli attributi del mese "corrente".
bibl.note: This contribution points out that the present participle of starts becoming the regular attribute of the "current month" from the middle of the II century CE at the earliest, whereas the perfect participle of remains the attribute for the "current year". These considerations necessitate corrections to the transcription or dating of various papyri.
